summary: Hanko startup program added to Sourcey as one entity and one offer, PR #1280.

observations.detail: PR #1280 adds exactly one file, entities/ha/hanko.yaml, holding one new entity and one offer. The shard directory and file name both derive from the slug 'hanko'. sha256 of the file as committed: 09e27a98ccf0fd6604910407ba955d1180808cfea232d82f19992dfc67750cb2.

The only source cited is https://www.hanko.io/startup-plan, a page on the vendor's own domain. Offer: One million free monthly active users for a Hanko Cloud organization, plus free consulting and setup support. Eligibility: For life or until the startup passes $500k ARR or raises more than $1M in VC funding.
Both required checks are green on the pull request head: 'sourcey/validation' success and 'validate catalog change' success. The commit carries a DCO Signed-off-by line matching the commit author.

The pinned Catalog Verifier was run locally before pushing: 'sourcey-catalog-verify validate startup-credits' reports 'Sourcey verification passed (entities: 1, programs: 0, offers: 1)' against the repository root set and the live parent release.
